description:
Exports all legal compliance documents currently attached to a registered website in clean Markdown ('markdown'), semantic HTML ('html'), or structured JSON ('json') format.

When to use vs. related tools: Call 'export_documents' AFTER generating and attaching documents to a siteId via 'generate_documents' or 'generate_docs_questionnaire' (or for a pre-seeded site like 'site_paperloo_sandbox'). Note: calling 'export_documents' on a site with zero attached documents returns an empty 'documents' array—generate documents with that 'siteId' first.

Preconditions & side effects: 'siteId' must exist in the active registry. Read-only transformation—does not mutate stored documents.

Returns: JSON object containing 'success: true', 'siteId', 'format', 'total_documents', 'documents' (each with 'type', 'title', 'version', 'word_count', 'content'), and 'message' (or 'error' + 'available_sites').

format.description: Target export representation: raw 'markdown', semantic '<article>' 'html', or serialized section-parsed 'json'.

siteId.description: Registered site UUID or exact registered URL whose documents should be exported.

name: export_documents

outputSchema.description: Exported site legal documents formatted as Markdown, HTML, or JSON.

available_sites.description: Registered sites returned when siteId does not match.

items.description: Summary entry for a registered monitored website.

documents.description: Formatted compliance documents attached to the site.

content.description: Serialized document body in Markdown, HTML, or JSON string form.

word_count.description: Word count of the underlying document.

error.description: Error message when siteId lookup or format validation fails.

message.description: Human-readable export summary or empty-state guidance.

success.description: True if document export succeeded; false if siteId or format is invalid.

total_documents.description: Number of documents returned for the site.

title: Export Site Legal Documents
